statements.clause: a reported move for Tresoldi involving AC Milan and Arsenal with a valuation of 60 million as early as January.

narratives.headline: AC Milan transfer interest in Tresoldi

statements.clause: AC Milan collapsed 0-3 in the Europa League after goalkeeper Maignan received a red card.
Bournemouth defeated AC Milan 3-0 in the Europa League after the goalkeeper was sent off.
Milan failed to make a substitution following Maignan's red card, a situation described as 'absolutely farcical'.

narratives.headline: AC Milan Europa League defeat and substitution error

statements.clause: Pavlovic's assessment that Milan are on the right track despite acknowledging too many mistakes were made.
